newsitem.title: JORDAN: Two women sentenced to death for murder in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Two women sentenced to death for murder in Jordan.

text.p: A Jordanian court has sentenced to death two women who murdered one of their husbands and hid his dismembered limbs and charred head in a cess pit, Al-Rai newspaper said on Saturday.
It said the two women, identified only by their first names Emira, 35, and Aida, 37, plotted to kill Emira's husband Murad after she complained that Murad beat her and was thinking of re-marrying.

The two women, telling Murad that he could take Aida as a mistress, enticed him into a room and told him to lie face down on the floor while Aida pretended to undress for him, the paper said. While he was on the floor Aida shot him.

The newspaper said the two women then cut Murad's body up into eight pieces, put them into plastic bags and threw them into a cess pit. They roasted his head on a gas burner for two hours so it would be unrecognisable.
Emira and Aida were caught after Aida told her relatives about the murder, Al-Rai said.

The paper said the women, from an unspecified Arab country, were sentenced to death by a court in the northern province of Irbid. It did not say when the murder took place or when the two women were sentenced.
The ruling follows death sentences imposed by Jordanian courts this month on two lovers for killing the woman's husband and a guard for murder during an attempted rape.

The human rights group Amnesty International says at least seven people have been hanged in Jordan this year and at least 14 had been sentenced to death before the ruling in Irbid. Amnesty has appealed for all the death sentences to be commuted.
